trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR (verified, no defect found — recorded so the next reader need not redo it). The LP-dual algebra checks out. Primal: min t.x over x in R^d free, with 1.x = n_target (multiplier y_0 free), Gx >= 0 (y >= 0), x_i >= -M (s_i >= 0). Because x is free the dual constraint is the equality y_0 + sum_i G_{ij} y_i + (boundedness multiplier) = t_j; the block's '<= t_j' with '- s_j' is the equivalent slack form, and G symmetric makes G_{ji} = G_{ij}, so the index order as written is harmless. Driving s -> 0 for large M gives exactly the effective dual and dual objective n_target * y_0*, which is the field AGENTS.md's LP/SDP rule requires as dual_obj. d = n! is the correct dimension of H_n(q) as stated (the separate question of whether G has full rank there is raised, correctly, in the sibling proof block).
